name: macbeth
summary: Macbeth pairs tactile luxury with sculptural strength. Wrapped in rich nubuck leather, its form is elevated by brushed brass accents in stainless steel—offering a refined harmony of softness and shine. The result is a bold yet sophisticated expression of modern elegance. 100x97x60(80) / 202x102x60(80) / 284.5x102x60/80
